endpoints.name: Delete Monthly Planner

idempotency.notes: Repeating the call after success will typically return not-found or no change

endpoints.detailed_description: Delete monthly planner. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IMonthlyPlanner.GetMonthlyPlannerById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: IndentPlanningHeader: UPDATE, soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.
